purpose: Actor-specific operational-method registry for recurrence detection. Similarity is an analytical lead, never proof of propensity, common intent, illegality or guilt.

anchor.label: PwC working meeting
anchor.source_date_caveat: The historical derivative transcript is labelled 11 June 2016; current repository control treats 10 June 2016 as canonical while preserving the historical label as a source literal.
anchor.attribution_caveat: Speaker labels and described capacities remain source/derivative attributions subject to the existing recording controls.

markers.label: ACCESS_CONTROL_FIRST
markers.description: Repeated prioritisation of access to the property or complex he said he administered.

markers.label: STRATEGIC_GAME_FRAMING
markers.description: Express framing of the dispute as a strategic game, including the recorded 'partida de póker' language.

markers.label: SEQUENCING_CONTROL
markers.description: Attempts to determine the order in which access, accounting, authority and settlement issues would be addressed.

markers.label: HARD_NEGOTIATING_PERIMETER
markers.description: Express negotiating red lines and refusal to proceed outside an accepted perimeter.

markers.label: ROLE_CONSTITUENCY_CROSS_CHECK
markers.description: Where Community-administrator language coexists with representation of Molina-family interests, test mandate, conflicts, beneficiary and authority separately.

markers.label: FORM_SUBSTANCE_STRUCTURING
markers.description: Formal-structuring awareness, including de derecho/de hecho distinctions and alternative forms for economic charges; legality and implementation remain separate questions.

markers.label: DEBT_CREDIT_ENFORCEMENT_LEVERAGE
markers.description: References to Community debt, credit or mortgage-credit sale, purchasers, enforcement and creditor-control consequences.

markers.label: DOCUMENTARY_LEGITIMISATION
markers.description: Promised audit, report, governing-body decision or similar product triggers a production, custody and later-use question.

anchor.label: Reported JDAM / Miguel Barreiro conversation
anchor.chronology_caveat: The 22 March 2018 Logalty/CallStamp event preserves or replays the earlier conversation and must not replace the underlying 26 February date.
anchor.attribution_caveat: The transcript uses interlocutor labels; person-specific attribution must remain tied to the surrounding authenticated record. A proposal is not proof that Miguel Barreiro accepted or implemented it.

markers.label: PRE_STATED_ACCESS_OBJECTIVE
markers.description: Access is discussed before the later material-control event.

markers.label: FORCE_COOPERATION_DUAL_ROUTE
markers.description: Language contrasts force-based and cooperative routes to access.

markers.label: INSIDER_FACILITATION_REQUEST
markers.description: An on-site person is asked to facilitate access.

markers.label: CONCEALMENT_STAGING_PROPOSAL
markers.description: Proposed concealment or staging of cooperation, including the recorded te haces el loco / paripé language.

markers.label: ANTICIPATED_DISPLACEMENT
markers.description: Statements predict incumbent displacement and entry by the speaker's side.

markers.label: AUTHORITY_OWNERSHIP_ASSERTION
markers.description: Ownership or entitlement assertions must be tested against title and authority existing on that date.

markers.label: COMMUNITY_LEGITIMATION
markers.description: An asserted agreement with the Community triggers production questions as to organ, date, vote, mandate, scope and document.

markers.label: SECURITY_EXCLUSION_ARCHITECTURE
markers.description: Anticipated security and exclusion are compared with later guard, locksmith, key, chain, access and instruction evidence.

markers.label: PREPARATION_FOR_WORKS_ECONOMIC_USE
markers.description: Measurements, photographs, refurbishment, operation, maintenance and surveillance proposals are tested against later implementation evidence.

markers.label: FUTURE_BENEFIT_LEVERAGE
markers.description: Where cooperation is linked to future work or opportunity, record the proposed mechanism without assuming acceptance or payment.

anchor.label: elEconomista / Javier Romera response-channel episode
anchor.provenance_caveat: Current evidence supports response-channel analysis. Personal location, framing or physical transmission by LPAM of Sentencia 163/2023 remains unresolved unless the native incoming communication closes that gap.
anchor.newsroom_safeguard: No adverse inference is made against Javier Romera or elEconomista merely because they sought documents, delayed publication or declined to publish.

markers.label: INFORMATION_GATE_INTERVENTION
markers.description: Record evidence that LPAM/CAM entered the response process while proposed publication was in advanced verification.

markers.label: DELAY_LINKED_TO_DOCUMENTARY_REBUTTAL
markers.description: Track the sequence in which publication was asked to wait while judicial material was promised.

markers.label: AUTHORITATIVE_DOCUMENT_COUNTER_NARRATIVE
markers.description: Test whether judicial, administrative or other authoritative documents were deployed or procured as rebuttal instruments and whether their scope was described accurately.

markers.label: SCOPE_COMPRESSION_TEST
markers.description: Compare what the document actually decides with the broader proposition it is used to answer; do not attribute framing personally without transmission or instruction evidence.

markers.label: CONTRADICTION_TEST
markers.description: Preserve incompatible contemporaneous positions as contradictions requiring authentication and resolution, not automatically as lies.

markers.label: EFFECT_ON_DECISION_ENVIRONMENT
markers.description: Record temporal and causal proximity where promised material is followed by a documented third-party decision change, while keeping intention separate.

markers.label: PROVENANCE_GAP
markers.description: Do not state as fact that LPAM personally located, framed or transmitted Sentencia 163/2023 until native evidence closes the provenance gap.

markers.label: NEWSROOM_INDEPENDENCE_SAFEGUARD
markers.description: No adverse inference against Romera or elEconomista from ordinary verification, delay or publication decisions alone.

preferred_conclusion_template: This episode exhibits operational features consistent with the actor's previously documented behavioural pattern, specifically [features]. The similarity is analytically relevant but does not prove common intent, illegality or that the earlier method was implemented here. Those propositions require the identified actor-specific evidential bridges.
prohibited_shortcut: Do not replace the evidential analysis with a character-based conclusion such as deceitful, manipulative or thug.
